card.name: Domestic violence support text
card.fires_on: Ordinary words inside web passages about domestic violence and abuse, such as support, of, about, for and you. It fires on the small words around the topic, not on one fixed term.

modes.label: Words in service descriptions
modes.description: Verbs and linking words in text describing groups that help survivors of domestic violence.
modes.example: legislation and policies that<< support>> survivors of domestic violence.

modes.label: Words in advice to victims
modes.description: Small words in advice for someone suffering or fearing abuse, about where to go or what to do.
modes.example: you should know where to go<< for>> help.

card.writes: It pushes toward crisis and shelter words such as crisis, evacuation and refuge.
card.plain: It lights up on everyday words in passages about domestic violence and help for victims.
